title: Whose verifier reaches the check?
description: Start an overlapping login, then send login A's callback and compare which verifier each host presents to a check built from A's challenge.
initialCaption: Each host holds the verifier for login A. Start a second login, or send A’s callback now and compare the two checks.
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: When login B starts while login A is still open, a host with one shared verifier slot replaces verifier A with B. Login A's callback then presents B, its teeth do not match the pins set by A's challenge, and no token is issued; a host that stores one verifier per login presents A and passes.
